## Before this will work
1. Create a **Supabase** credential (same one as the outbound workflow) and attach it to both Supabase HTTP Request nodes.
2. Create an **HTTP Header Auth** credential for Meta (same one as outbound) and attach it to "Send WhatsApp Reply".
3. Activate this workflow once, then copy the **Production URL** shown on the "Receive Inbound Message" webhook node -- that's what goes into Meta's App Dashboard > WhatsApp > Configuration > Callback URL.
4. Pick your own Verify Token (any random string) and put the EXACT SAME value in two places: the "Verify Token Matches?" IF node below, AND Meta's Callback URL config field.
5. Open the CONFIG node and fill in your real Supabase URL, WhatsApp Phone Number ID, and general office number.
6. Use "Test Workflow" (bottom of canvas) to send yourself a test payload via the Manual Trigger before relying on real Meta traffic.

## Why there are no Code nodes
This workflow originally used 3 Code nodes (Extract & Filter Message, Parse Contact Result, Pick Most Recent Evaluation). They're rebuilt here as Set/Edit Fields nodes instead, because Code nodes run through n8n Cloud's separate sandboxed "task runner" process, which failed 100% of the time on this account during testing of the outbound workflow. Set nodes use a different, non-sandboxed expression evaluator and aren't affected. "Extract & Filter Message" can no longer return zero items the way Code could (Set always outputs exactly one item), so a new "Message Qualifies?" IF node does that filtering instead -- non-text messages and delivery receipts route to "Ignored (non-text or receipt)" and stop there, same net effect as before.

assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const raw = $input.all(); const rows = Array.isArray(raw[0]?.json) ? raw[0].json : raw.map(i => i.json); const evaluations = rows.map(r => r.evaluations).filter(Boolean); if (evaluations.length === 0) return false; evaluations.sort((a, b) => { const at = a.scheduled_at || a.date_captured; const bt = b.scheduled_at || b.date_captured; return new Date(bt) - new Date(at); }); const agent = evaluations[0].agent; return !!(agent && agent.full_name && agent.phone_number); })() }}
